infoPanel_Content:
Welcome to BTU.HAWKI - the chatbot interface of the IKMZ at BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg!

BTU.HAWKI provides you with the functionalities of ChatGPT and other AI language models. These are integrated into the portal via a data protection-compliant API (Application Programming Interface). It can be accessed via a web interface after logging in with your BTU account.

Before you begin, we ask that you familiarise yourself with our terms of use to ensure the safe and effective use of our services. You confirm the terms of use the first time you log in. You can view them at any time by clicking on the gear symbol in the settings

Further information about BTU.HAWKI and current training offers can be found in the FAQs.

Would you like to learn more about how generative AI tools are used at BTU? Visit the following information pages for useful tips and current information:

  • Using generative AI in university teaching
  • Using generative AI tools in scientific work

If you have any questions, please contact: ki-support@b-tu.de
usage_guideline:
Terms of Use

for the HAWKI instance of BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg (BTU.HAWKI)
(Effective Date: 07.02.2025)

1. Registration and Access

Access to the BTU.HAWKI service requires a BTU user account. Having a BTU user account implies acceptance of the BTU Cottbus Network Usage Policy dated 28.08.2009 (published in the BTU Cottbus Official Bulletin, 08/2009). Please note that you are responsible for all activities conducted under your account. Sharing your account credentials or allowing others to use your account is not permitted.

2. Authorized Use

You may use the technology or services only for authorized and lawful purposes and must comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and third-party rights, including local, federal, international laws, and the statutes, policies, and guidelines of BTU.

2.1. Prohibitions

As a user, you are prohibited from using this service to transmit, generate, or distribute content that:

  • is used for illegal, harmful, or abusive activities,
  • causes infringement, misuse, or violation of the rights of others,
  • contains confidential or sensitive information or data,
  • violates data protection laws, including the collection or dissemination of personal data without consent,
  • is fraudulent, deceptive, harmful, or misleading,
  • is discriminatory, promotes violence, hate speech, or illegal activities,
  • encourages self-harm, harassment, bullying, violence, or terrorism,
  • is sexually explicit unless required for educational or scientific purposes,
  • violates intellectual property rights or other legal and ethical rules related to online activities,
  • attempts to bypass IT security measures or intentionally violates existing IT policies,
  • could have unfair or adverse effects on individuals.

Additionally, the following activities are prohibited:

  • Reverse engineering, decompilation, or disassembly of the code,
  • Unauthorized activities such as spamming, spreading malware, or disruptive actions that degrade service quality,
  • Modifying, copying, renting, selling, or distributing the service.

3. Service Reliability

The results generated by the BTU.HAWKI AI service may not always be definitive, fully accurate, or precise. They may contain inaccuracies despite appearing detailed. Users should not rely solely on these results without independently verifying their accuracy. Furthermore, the information provided by the service may not always be complete or up to date and may not fully align with BTU's applicable policies and guidelines.

4. User Responsibilities

Usage should be exercised with appropriate caution, and results generated by the service should not serve as the sole basis for critical decisions or evaluations. Since AI and machine learning are continuously evolving, users must evaluate the accuracy of the results before using or disseminating them. Automated results concerning individuals should not be used in ways that could have a significant impact on them.

Users are responsible for the authorship of generated outputs. This includes ensuring the quality of the response and assuming responsibility for the input provided and resulting output. Users must verify that their input does not infringe any rights and that they possess all necessary rights, licenses, and permissions for its submission.

When using AI-generated results, users must clearly indicate the involvement of AI, for example, in accordance with citation rules and good scientific practices.

5. Third-Party Services

The BTU.HAWKI service may integrate software, products, or services from third parties, referred to as "third-party services," which deliver output known as "third-party output." These may include commercial and non-commercial large language models (LLMs) such as OpenAI's ChatGPT or ChatAI by GWDG (Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung Göttingen). Please note that third-party services operate independently and are subject to their own terms. Therefore, BTU is not responsible for third-party services or their terms. BTU does not control these services and is not liable for any loss or damage resulting from their use. Users interact with third-party services via the BTU.HAWKI portal at their own discretion and assume full responsibility for generated results. Additionally, BTU cannot provide guarantees regarding the performance or reliability of third-party services.

6. User Feedback / Evaluation

We appreciate your feedback and participation in the evaluation of the BTU.HAWKI service. Your suggestions and impressions help us improve the service. By submitting feedback, you agree that we may disclose, publish, or utilize it without financial compensation. Feedback is evaluated anonymously, and BTU reserves the right to use it for any purpose without confidentiality restrictions, regardless of whether it is marked as confidential.

You can find the feedback/evaluation link on the BTU.HAWKI homepage.

7. Data Protection

Protecting the privacy of user inquiries is fundamental to BTU. Therefore, the service stores your chat history only in your browser, not on the server. This history can be deleted at any time. Neither requests nor responses are permanently stored by BTU. Only the number of requests per user and timestamps are recorded to monitor system usage and facilitate billing. The storage of requests by third-party providers is governed by their terms.

For technical purposes, the following data is collected and stored in BTU web server log files:

  • IP address of the requesting device
  • Date and time of access
  • Access status (e.g., file transferred, not found)
  • Browser and operating system identification data (if provided by the browser)
  • Website from which access occurred (if provided by the browser)
  • Name, URL, and data volume of retrieved files (if applicable)

This data is not transferred to third parties and is not stored with other personal user data.

Detailed information on data protection can be found in BTU's data protection policy at: https://www.b-tu.de/datenschutz

The applicable OpenAI terms of use can be found at: openai.com/de-DE/policies/terms-of-use/

Please pay specific attention to Microsoft's content review policy: to detect and prevent malicious use of the Azure OpenAI service, Microsoft logs the content you send to the APIs and the content the service sends back. If content is flagged by the service's filters, it can be reviewed by a full-time Microsoft employee.

The applicable GWDG terms of use can be found at: docs.hpc.gwdg.de/services/chat-ai/terms_of_use.de
